title: Better Language Models and Their Implications (GPT-2)
summary: OpenAI published Better Language Models and Their Implications on February 14, 2019, introducing GPT-2 as a large transformer-based language model with 1.5 billion parameters and describing an initial staged-release approach in which a much smaller model and technical paper were released while the full trained model was withheld.
significance: A documented language-model milestone combining a major GPT-family scale increase with an explicitly staged model-release strategy.

verification.note: The February 14 2019 publication date, GPT-2 name, 1.5-billion-parameter scale, transformer-based description, and initial partial-release strategy are supported by OpenAI's first-party milestone page. The date is attached to this documented public milestone, not asserted as the model's training-completion or internal creation date. No geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationships are inferred.
